reason: None of the cited evidence addresses tribo-corrosion, sliding-induced grain refinement, dynamic amorphization, or the coupled wear-corrosion response in HEAs. E1 discusses irradiation resistance, E2 covers microwave cladding and SOFC applications, E3 notes that fine grains weaken the passive layer but in a static corrosion context without wear, and E4 describes boron-doped coatings for separate wear and corrosion resistance. The key premises thus lack specific prior support from the cited passages.
premises: High strain-rate sliding induces severe grain refinement and dynamic amorphization in the near-surface zone of HEAs
This nanocrystalline/amorphous layer increases hardness and reduces friction, enhancing wear resistance
The microstructural transformation disrupts the continuity and protective quality of the passive oxide film
Disrupted passive film leads to accelerated localized corrosion
Overall degradation is governed by a trade-off between improved wear resistance and accelerated corrosion
